Create a finished, premium Anrotex social sharing cover for a technical guide. Output exactly 1200 by 630 pixels, landscape 1.90476:1. Use the supplied image only as a brand/style reference: retain the same Anrotex A logo and Anrotex wordmark with yellow dot, warm off-white #F3F2EA background, deep navy #09324A bold geometric sans-serif typography, teal #1B6F81 and mint #AED0C9 illustration, a very small bright-yellow #FFFB08 accent. Match the reference's refined tactile paper / subtly dimensional clay illustration, quiet depth and generous space. Brand lockup small in the upper left. Large readable guide headline aligned left in the middle left, with shorter subtitle below. Distinct guide-topic illustration on the right. Small "anrotex.com" at bottom left. No screenshot or website interface frame. Keep every letter and the illustration inside at least 55px safe margins. Make headline readable at thumbnail scale. Render only the specified exact text and brand name; no extra labels, statistics, badges, claims, dates, watermark or editorial wording. The card should be one cohesive full-bleed landscape asset, not a collage of variants.

Illustration: a sculpted teal cloud above a compact group of three off-white server blocks, a small mint-and-navy cost ring and a restrained checklist with three tick marks. No numerical data or chart suggesting achieved results. No AWS trademark logo or partner badge.
